# pve_realms (Data Source)

Lists every authentication realm in the Proxmox VE cluster, including the built-ins `pam` and `pve`, as reported by `GET /access/domains`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_realms" "all" {}

output "authentication_realms" {
  value = [for r in data.pve_realms.all.realms : "${r.realm} (${r.type})"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Static identifier for the realm index.
- `realms` (Attributes List) Authentication realms configured in the cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--realms))

<a id="nestedatt--realms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `realms`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) Description shown in the PVE login window; null when unset.
- `realm` (String) Authentication domain ID.
- `tfa` (String) Two-factor authentication provider; one of `yubico` or `oath` when enabled, null otherwise.
- `type` (String) Realm type: one of `ad`, `ldap`, `openid`, `pam`, or `pve`.
